title: COVID-19
description: We collect images and annotate them with medical imaging specialists. In particular, COVID-19 includes 1,517 NORMAL cases, 1,467 PNEUMONIA cases, and 439 COVID cases gathered from standard international radiography repositories with expert physician verification.
highlights: Expert-annotated cases: 1,517 Normal cases, 1,467 Pneumonia cases, and 439 COVID-19 cases.
Multi-source aggregation: COVID-19 Radiography Database, Covid-19 Image Dataset, and high-quality clinical hospital records.

title: UIT-DODV
description: UIT-DODV is the first Vietnamese document image dataset, including 2,394 images with four classes: Table, Figure, Caption, Formula. Converted 1,696 images from PDF, 247 images scanned from physical scanners, and expanded with 451 images scanned from smartphones.
highlights: Variety of images: PDF conversions, physical flatbed scans, and smartphone handheld scans with perspective distortions.
Variety of layout: Papers from scientific conferences/journals covering single-column and two-column templates.
Fine-grained layout objects: Simultaneous detection of Table, Figure, Caption, and mathematical Formula.

title: UIT-VEMC21
description: Vietnamese Ethnic Minority Costumes Classification (UIT-VEMC21) benchmark, consisting of the 10 largest ethnic groups in Vietnam: Tay, Thai, Muong, H'Mong, Dao, Ede, Ba Na, Cham, San Diu, and Ra Glai.
highlights: 10 ethnic categories carefully verified and labeled by cultural experts.
Samples collected from 10 volunteers wearing and changing 2-3 traditional outfits.
Photographed under diverse daytime lighting conditions across clear and cloudy weather.

title: UIT-VinaFruit20
description: UIT-VinaFruit20 contains 63,541 images corresponding to 20 popular Vietnamese fruits, averaging about 3,700 images per class. It is the first comprehensive Vietnamese fruit recognition benchmark addressing high intra-class variance.
highlights: Diversity in ripeness: Includes fruits from unripe green stages to fully ripe harvest colors.
High intra-class variation: Covers diverse shapes, regional variants, and low inter-class color distances.
Contextual clutter: Fruits photographed in natural farm orchards, market baskets, and festive meal preparations.

title: UIT-CVID21
description: UIT-CVID21 (Classifying Vehicle In Image From Drone) contains 10,000 images covering four primary vehicle classes: bus, car, truck, and van, captured from unmanned aerial vehicles reflecting the dynamics of Vietnamese roadways.
highlights: 10,000 high-resolution aerial vehicle images across four primary transport categories.
Diverse bird's-eye and oblique camera angles capturing small objects in dense traffic.
Realistic Vietnamese urban road conditions for traffic density and flow management.

title: UIT-Drone21
description: A novel drone benchmark dataset to advance aerial video analysis under complex scenarios. Includes 23 short video sequences totaling approximately 15,370 fully annotated frames for object detection and visual tracking.
highlights: 23 video sequences with 13,066 fully annotated frames with bounding boxes.
Multi-task benchmark: Object Detection, Single-Object Tracking (SOT), and Multiple Object Tracking (MOT).
2,304 supplementary frames specifically annotated for complex small-object detection.

title: UIT-Flower
description: UIT-Flower dataset includes 81,909 images across 21 flowers native and popular in Vietnam, presenting challenging fine-grained botanical classification problems with high color and morphology variance.
highlights: 81,909 images across 21 botanical flower classes.
Wide color variation within single species under regional environmental factors.
Visual clutter: Flowers photographed in bouquets, vases, garden settings, and festive decorations.

title: Vina-Food21
description: VinaFood21 contains 13,950 images corresponding to 21 iconic dishes, establishing a comprehensive milestone for complex Vietnamese food recognition encompassing street food and daily meals.
highlights: 13,950 curated food images across 21 iconic Vietnamese dishes.
2~3 times larger category coverage than prior Vietnamese food benchmarks.
High intra-class variation across restaurant plating, street vendors, and home kitchens.

title: UIT-Anomaly
description: The UIT-Anomaly dataset includes 224 muted surveillance videos captured at 30 fps (over 200 minutes, 392,188 frames) featuring 104 normal and 120 anomalous videos across 18 typical Vietnamese scenes.
highlights: Over 200 minutes of video footage with 314,843 training frames and 77,345 testing frames.
First video anomaly benchmark captured in Vietnamese urban settings (roads, storefronts, parking lots).
Covers 6 distinct classes of anomalies across 18 diverse backgrounds and illumination conditions.

title: VNAnomaly
description: The VNAnomaly dataset consists of 89 training videos and 96 evaluating videos capturing real-world unsupervised anomalies in Vietnamese streets: fighting, assault, vandalism, and robbery.
highlights: Unsupervised anomaly benchmark tailored for Vietnamese public street safety.
578,609 training frames and 75,214 evaluating frames—substantially larger than standard benchmarks.
36 distinct camera scenes triple the scene diversity of the ShanghaiTech dataset.

title: UIT-TASTET21
description: UIT-TASTET21 presents 77,000 images divided into 63,840 training and 14,041 test images covering 18 traditional dishes and festive delicacies typically prepared during the Vietnamese Lunar New Year (Tet).
highlights: 77,000 images representing 18 traditional Vietnamese Tet holiday delicacies.
Includes rare and culturally significant festive foods (Banh in, Candied Ginger, Candied Kumquat).
High visual noise from tableware, celebratory tablecloths, and festive decorative elements.

title: UIT-VinaDeveS22
description: A real-world traffic surveillance video dataset collected from the Vietnam Department of Transportation portal, presenting realistic traffic density, road topologies, and meteorological variations for computer vision models.
highlights: Official DOT portal source reflecting genuine Vietnamese metropolitan traffic dynamics.
6 multi-camera perspectives across crossroads, single carriageways, and dual carriageways.
Diverse meteorological conditions including daytime, nighttime, clear weather, and heavy rain.

title: UIT-DODV-Ext
description: UIT-DODV-Ext is the largest Vietnamese document image dataset with 5,000 images across textbooks and scientific papers for Table, Figure, and Caption detection, captured via smartphones, flatbed scanners, and PDF conversions.
highlights: 5,000 document images spanning secondary textbooks and peer-reviewed scientific journals.
Multi-source capture: Smartphone cameras, physical hardware scanners, and direct PDF renderings.
Robust layout analysis across single-column, two-column, and reform textbook layouts.
